findings: thread_halt rejects self via panic; must_halt0 orders current/target locks and can fail5 if current halt request; must_halt1 locks target and bypasses those local interruption failures.
successful halt increments target hold count, sets suspend bit, coordinates existing halt owner/waiter, then calls thread_dowait; nonzero result clears halt request, wakes and releases hold.
thread_dowait must_halt1 has own return variable0 and does not take post-sleep failure5 edge; does not prove bounded wait, run queue/scheduler correctness or callee return.
after dowait, clear_wait(T,2,1) is conditional on state bit8; direct exception/bootstrap continuation or successful mach_msg_interrupt permits state bit10 and clearing T17c bit0.
other continuations require low state2, set low bitsc, thread_setrun(T,0) then repeat wait; halt success is not simply thread_dowait returning0.

self halt with T17c bit2 set performs IPC terminate, thread_hold, reaper enqueue using T0/T4, state bit10, queue wakeup and block with walking_zombie panic continuation; no own refcount decrement/reset or PCB free.
self nontermination halt sets state bit10, clears request bit0 and blocks with supplied continuation or exception return; no reaper enqueue on that branch.

ipc_thread/task terminate gate on own self-port pointer under lock, clear it before unlocked cleanup; repeated own gate0 returns but not full concurrent cleanup completion, port/ref alias or republishing closure.
ast_check running processor path ORs thread T17c into need_ast. check_for_ast captures mask under raw CLI, removes captured bits, prioritizes local T17c&3 self halt, then scheduling and FP AST.
thread_block clears need_ast bit2, selects/invokes until nonzero; same-thread continuation dispatch, stack-handoff, stack allocation/swapin retry and regular switch are different paths.
invoke and dispatch clear old running bit and wake exact event T48 waiters; two fifteen-entry wakeup tables have same state categories, while clear_wait defaults are no-op instead of panic.
call_continuation passes function and stack pointer; __call_with_stack reads ESP+4 and ESP+8, replaces ESP/EBP and JMPs function, not ordinary C call/return; decompiler loses second physical input.
conditional initial running4 self-hold/stop and successful selected switch reaches state112 and reaper low2, accepted by prior destructor mask; no runtime/native safety proof.
thread_release clears suspend/halted bits only when prior hold count1; other values just decrement including invalid zero arithmetic, not actual observed underflow.
raw need_ast literal writer/direct caller survey is bounded and not all alias/indirect/out-of-function writer closure.
